en: Mom
See, {player}? The movers' Vigoroth are doing all the heavy lifting. Isn't that something?
text: Vezi, {player}? Vigorothii celor de la mutări fac toată treaba grea. Grozav, nu?

en: Your room is upstairs. Go and have a look! And Dad bought you a new clock. Set it for me, would you?
text: Camera ta e sus. Du-te să te uiți! Și tata ți-a cumpărat un ceas nou. Mi-l potrivești tu, te rog?

en: Mom
{player}! Quick, come here! It's Dad's Gym on the television! Petalburg City!
text: {player}! Repede, vino încoace! E Arena lui tata la televizor! Orașul Petalburg!

en: ...the Gym's Leader, Norman, has kept his team in fine form this season. That's all from Petalburg...
text: ...Liderul Arenei, Norman, și-a ținut echipa în formă bună sezonul ăsta. Atât de la Petalburg...

en: Oh! It's over already. We missed him. What a shame!
text: O! S-a terminat deja. L-am ratat. Ce păcat!

en: Your father has his Gym in Petalburg City now, so we'll see more of him. You should go and visit him.
text: Tatăl tău are acum Arena în Orașul Petalburg, așa că o să-l vedem mai des. Ar trebui să mergi să-l vizitezi.

en: But first, go next door and say hello. Professor Birch lives there, and his child is just about your age!
text: Dar întâi du-te alături și salută-i pe vecini. Acolo locuiește Profesorul Birch, iar copilul lui e cam de vârsta ta!

en: Mom
{player}! You're up! The whole of Littleroot is talking about you. My child, the Champion of Hoenn!
Oh, but come and look, quick! There's a special report on the television.
...we interrupt this programme for a report from across Hoenn. A Pokémon nobody can name has been seen flying over the routes.
It flies faster than a jet, they say. But no two people who saw it can agree on what colour it was...
I only caught a glimpse of it out of the window this morning. What colour did it look like to you, {player}?
What colour was the Pokémon?
RED
BLUE
Red? Then it might be the one the old stories call Latias. Fancy that, flying about Hoenn right now!
Blue? Then it might be the one the old stories call Latios. Fancy that, flying about Hoenn right now!
Dad
{player}! I came as soon as I heard. The Champion! I always knew you'd go further than me one day.
I've brought you something. Think of it as a present from a proud father.
That ticket lets you board the S.S. Tidal at Slateport or Lilycove. And ships out of Lilycove go much further still.
Well, a Gym Leader can't stay away from his Gym for long. Look after your mother, {player}. I'll see you soon!
Mom
That's your father for you. He was so proud he could hardly stand still!
Mom
Wait, {player}! You haven't even seen your room yet. And don't forget to set the clock!
text: Stai, {player}! Nici nu ți-ai văzut camera. Și nu uita să potrivești ceasul!

en: Mom
You look tired out, sweetie. Sit down for a minute and catch your breath.
text: Se vede pe tine oboseala. Stai jos un minut și trage-ți sufletul.

en: There, all better! Your Pokémon look happier already. Don't forget to come home now and then.
text: Gata, acum e mai bine! Pokémonii tăi arată deja mai fericiți. Nu uita să mai vii acasă din când în când.

en: Mom
Go on upstairs and see your room, {player}. The clock won't set itself!
text: Du-te sus să-ți vezi camera, {player}. Ceasul nu se potrivește singur!
